words.gloss: is it an elixir of immortality?

literal: Is it an elixir of immortality, the life that preserves the flesh, when great dignity and honour are ruined?
translation: When one's great dignity and honour are ruined, is the life spent in preserving this fleshly body an elixir of immortality?
modern: பெருந்தன்மையும் மானமும் அழியும்படியான நிலைமை வரும்போது, உடம்பைக் காப்பாற்றிக் கொண்டு வாழ்கின்ற வாழ்க்கை என்ன சாகா மருந்தா?
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme value of self-respect over mere physical survival. The poet asks a rhetorical question: when a situation arises where one's great dignity (பெருந்தகைமை) and honour (பீடு) are destroyed, is preserving this physical body (ஊன்) with life (வாழ்க்கை) like consuming an elixir of immortality (மருந்து)? Since physical life is temporary anyway, sacrificing one's honour just to keep the body alive is futile and ignoble.
